name: hail_taxi
text: A standing person near a street lifts the RIGHT arm high and waves broadly twice to hail a taxi, leaning forward slightly. Then finish the wave, lower the right arm fully to hang relaxed by the right thigh and straighten the torso. The left arm hangs naturally beside the left thigh. Finish upright and still with both arms down. Feet stay planted.
